newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - low sulphur tracks crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - low sulphur tracks crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run activity was muted as prices played catch up with soaring crude and then had to ease.

Strong gas oil and gasoline prices were prompting some dealers to turn away from straight-run to maximise distillate output. But some traders felt now was a good time to buy, even though outright prices appeared very strong. "The last time crude was at $23 a barrel straight-run went as high as $145 fob NWE," said one trader. "I wish I had room at the refinery... Straight-run margins are better than crude." Prices were assesed in the mid $130s for fob NWE. --London newsroom +44 171 542 8980
